data.name: Anselmus
data.long_meaning:
Anselmus is a Latin name derived from the Latin word anselmus, meaning 'God with a defense'. It was a common name among the early Christian saints, and was especially popular among the Benedictine monks.

St. Anselm of Canterbury, who lived from 1033 to 1109, is one of the most famous bearers of this name. He was a prominent theologian, philosopher, and monk, and is best known for his development of the ontological argument for the existence of God.

Anselm's spiritual significance lies in his unwavering faith and dedication to God. He is a symbol of courage in the face of adversity, and his intellectual pursuits serve as a reminder of the power of knowledge and reason in the pursuit of truth.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage and faith in the face of adversity

in_hebrew.name: אנסלמוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אנסלמוס הוא שם שמקורו בגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השומר שלי'. השם מורכב מ'אנס' שפירושו 'אלוהים' ומ'אלמוס' שפירושו 'הוא השומר'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה.

in_greek.name: Άνσελμος
in_greek.meaning: ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Άνσελμος είναι ένα όνομα γερμανικής προέλευσης που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ο προστάτης μου'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από το 'Άνς' που σημαίνει 'Θεός' και το 'Ελμος' που σημαίνει 'προστάτης'. Το όνομα αυτό έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί από τους Χριστιανούς και έχει βαθιά πνευματική σημασία.

in_latin.name: Anselmus
in_latin.long_meaning: Anselmus est nomen Germanicum quod significat 'Deus est custos meus'. Nomen constat ex 'Anse' quod significat 'Deus' et 'elmus' quod significat 'custos'. Nomen hoc usitatum est inter Christianos et habet profundam significationem spiritualem.

seo.description_paragraph:
Anselmus is a Latin name with a rich history and profound significance in Christianity. Derived from the Latin word anselmus, meaning 'God with a defense', this name was borne by many early Christian saints and was particularly popular among the Benedictine monks.

One of the most famous bearers of this name was St. Anselm of Canterbury, who lived from 1033 to 1109. He was a prominent theologian, philosopher, and monk, and is best known for his development of the ontological argument for the existence of God.

The spiritual significance of Anselmus lies in its reminder of God's protection and defense. It is a name that symbolizes courage in the face of adversity and the power of knowledge and reason in the pursuit of truth.
